# Georgy Dunaev — Software Engineer & Formal Verification Specialist

> Personal academic and engineering homepage of Georgy Dunaev (`https://georgydunaev.github.io`), Software Engineer and Formal Verification Specialist, creator of the Obelisk Proof Assistant (`MKTD1-system` & `MKTD2-system`), and researcher in mathematical logic, Morse-Kelley / NBG class theory, dependent type theory, and verified software systems.

Non-attacking AI agents, academic search indexers, and answer engines are welcomed. For direct, zero-HTML-noise context, inspect `/llms-full.txt`, `/assets/meta/person_schema.json`, and the Markdown endpoints on the companion Obelisk Proof Assistant portal.

## Structured Profile & Agent Endpoints

- [Complete Agent Biography & Research Summary (`llms-full.txt`)](https://georgydunaev.github.io/llms-full.txt): Self-contained Markdown dossier of Georgy Dunaev's education, publications, formal verification architecture, and projects.
- [Canonical Schema.org Person Record (JSON-LD)](https://georgydunaev.github.io/assets/meta/person_schema.json): Machine-readable structured identity record.
- [Curriculum Vitae (English PDF)](https://georgydunaev.github.io/CV_EN.pdf): Full academic and industry CV in English.
- [Curriculum Vitae (German PDF)](https://georgydunaev.github.io/CV_DE.pdf): Full academic and industry CV in German.

## Obelisk Proof Assistant & Mathematical Foundations

- [Obelisk Proof Assistant Portal](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/): Main portal for `MKTD1-system` (118 sequent-calculus entries) and `MKTD2-system` (220 constructive dependent-type theorems).
- [Obelisk LLMs Index (`llms.txt`)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/llms.txt): Agent-first Markdown and JSON endpoints for Obelisk Proof Assistant.
- [Foundations of Mathematics and the Obelisk Proof Assistant (PDF, 424 pages)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/foundations.pdf): Comprehensive monograph on `MKTD1-framework`, `MKTD2-framework`, Dunaev Tagged Ordered Pairs, and Grothendieck-Tarski universes.
- [MKTD1-system Complete Reference Manual (Markdown)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/generated/manual.md): Pure Markdown export of all 118 `MKTD1-system` entries.
- [MKTD2-system Constructive Theorem Library (Markdown)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/generated/nbg_library.md): Pure Markdown export of all 220 `MKTD2-system` records.
